xna-type.name: ContainmentType
xna-type.summary: Indicates the extent to which bounding volumes intersect or contain one another.

member.name: Contains
member.summary: Indicates that one bounding volume completely contains the other.

member.name: Disjoint
member.summary: Indicates there is no overlap between the bounding volumes.

member.name: Intersects
member.summary: Indicates that the bounding volumes partially overlap.
